fields.name: origin fade range{origin fade distance}:world units#distance beyond cutoff over which tracers fade
origin fade cutoff:world units#distance from tracer origin where fade begins
edge fade range:degrees#degrees beyond cutoff over which tracers fade
edge fade cutoff:degrees#degrees away from edge-on where fade is total
profile self acceleration#world units per second-squared
sort bias#use values between -10 and 10 to move closer and farther from camera (positive is closer)
uv tiling:u lengthwise, v crosswise#u is tiles/world unit, v is absolute tiles
angle fade range:degrees#radial (from tracer axis) degrees beyond beginning angle over which tracer fades
angle fade begin:degrees#radial (from tracer axis) degrees away from face-on where fade begins

options: point-to-point#skips the update step, and ignores lifespan, for point-to-point effects
draw in first person pass (dangerous)#use this only if the entire tracer is in "first person space"; can lead to depth artifacts if misused
has at least one extern texture used
